messages:
leo: Quick design check-in: proposing we merge Models + Routes + Jobs into a single collapsible 'Workloads' rail group. Goal: reduce vertical clutter so breadcrumbs + compact actions fit on smaller screens. Sketch attached in Figma. Thoughts?

anya: Love reducing clutter. Two concerns: 1) users that expect direct 'Models' link might be confused, 2) our help docs reference /models/ in examples. Can we keep shallow routes for backward compat? :eyes:

cheng: Tech constraints: router currently maps many places to named routes. Suggest canonicalize to `/org/:orgId/workloads/:kind/:itemId`. Add redirects from `/org/:orgId/models/:id` etc. Use router.replace so history doesn't get noisy.

frank: UX follow-up: breadcrumb should read "Org > Workloads > Models > tiny-title" or maybe collapse intermediate when space limited to "Org > Workloads > ... > item". Hover reveals full path. Also show a compact crumb when the left rail is collapsed.

leo: Good call. I want breadcrumbs to be linkable: clicking a crumb navigates and preserves collapsed state if possible. Deep link into an item should expand the group and focus the row but not steal scroll.

cheng: Example middleware (very small):
```js
// on navigation
if (path.match(/^\/org\/\d+\/models\//)) {
  const id = path.split('/').pop()
  router.replace(`/org/${orgId}/workloads/models/${id}`)
  analytics.track('redirect_models')
}
```
Keep server-side redirects for shared links too.

anya: Accessibility bits: when expanding via deep link, announce with `aria-live=\"polite\"` ("Models section expanded"). Make sure focus lands on the item and focus ring is visible. Keyboard users need a predictable tab order.

frank: Question about search: if we hide top-level Models, how will keyboard shortcut + search behave? I propose pinned search result type 'Models' that surfaces top matches and an action to open the group. Also surface the item type in the crumb shortlabel like "(M)" for Models to aid recognition.

leo: Nice micro-affordance. Also, please add a migration doc for third-party links and internal docs. We should list all known paths that will be redirected and include curls for testing.

aria-bot: Reminder: Design review scheduled Thu 11am. Please add your checklist items to the meeting doc.

cheng: I'll add unit + e2e tests for router redirects and for not creating extra history entries during animations. Test cases: deep-link into collapsed group, keyboard focus after expand, server-side redirect status 301 for legacy links.

anya: I'll draft a copy change for the left rail tooltip text and update docs referencing /models/. Also want to test with a small group of users in beta before global roll.

leo: OK consensus path: 1) implement router redirects + tests, 2) prototype expand animation with focus + a11y announcements, 3) update search pin and docs, 4) beta. Assigning: @cheng router/tests, @anya docs & copy, @frank search behaviour, @leo prototype animation. Thanks :thumbsup:
